text:
maria: Quick update — we rolled the sequence-aware coalescer canary to 10% traffic and saw immediate wins. p50 down ~18ms, p99 down ~120ms on long sequences, cost per 1M tokens ~ -6%.

alex: nice!! can you paste numbers? :rocket:

maria: benchmark summary from perf-ci:
```
model: redwood-13b-2026-v2
workload: chat-long (avg seq 1024)
p50 before: 74ms -> after: 56ms
p95 before: 210ms -> after: 150ms
p99 before: 780ms -> after: 660ms
cost/1M tokens: $4.28 -> $4.02
```

jia: what changed exactly? is this batching or kernel-level?

maria: it's two parts: 1) sequence-aware coalescer that groups requests by remaining tokens to reduce KV cache churn, 2) scheduler tweak to avoid tiny partial-batches at tail. no model changes.

sam: any regressions on short sequences?

maria: short sequences (<= 64) unchanged; we verified latencies stable. running more canaries tomorrow — expanding to 30% at 09:00 PST unless objections.

alex: +1, please add a rollback tag on the canary if p99 > 700ms

oncall-bot: deploy canary started (config: runtime.coalescer.enabled=true, runtime.coalescer.window_ms=8) — canary id: c-20260316-21

maria: ops note — key config keys:
- runtime.coalescer.enabled
- runtime.coalescer.bucket_by_remaining
- scheduler.tail_coalesce_ms

maria: simple test command for local perf runs:
```
PYTHONPATH=. ./perf/run_bench.py --model redwood-13b-2026-v2 --seq 1024 --clients 64 --duration 600
```

jia: can we add a small e2e smoke to ensure no correctness regressions? some prompts with structured output.

maria: already in progress. running eval-set 'structured-outputs-v2' as part of canary gate.

alex: thanks — will update docs/notes and add a short blurb to release notes. :tada:

perf-ci: perf results uploaded: https://perf.redwood.internal/artifacts/c-20260316-21/benchmark-summary.html

sam: great work team. bring to 100% once SRE gives green.
